name: Mesa County, CO
findings: Mesa County has 492 nonprofit organizations. 233 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 170 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Mesa County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Health care organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 13 health care organizations here list public events, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Mesa County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).
